title: Payments firm settles FTC fees case
snippet: Riverside Payments and its affiliates agreed to pay $600,000 to resolve allegations they misled small businesses about processing costs.

title: Binance users in some European countries told to pull crypto before fees kick in, with accounts closing by year end
snippet: Affected accounts are reportedly set to close on Dec. 31. Users in Spain, France, and Poland say they've received similar notices.

title: Xiaomi’s humanoid robots work a full 8-hour shift in its EV factory
snippet: Xiaomi has released footage of its humanoid robots working a full 8-hour shift at its EV factory, sorting center console side covers for its cars. The company says the robots did it on their own, catching and fixing their own mistakes along the way. If that’s fully autonomous, it’s truly impressive. But we’ve been disappointed by humanoid robot demos before, and Xiaomi left out the numbers that would let anyone check. more…

title: Puerto Rico tapped Sunrun’s home batteries for 18 straight days
